SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN ABS(CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) - CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)) BETWEEN 0 AND 2 THEN '0-2 days'
    WHEN ABS(CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) - CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)) BETWEEN 3 AND 5 THEN '3-5 days'
    WHEN ABS(CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) - CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)) BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN '6-10 days'
    ELSE '11+ days'
  END AS delivery_time_bucket,
  AVG(r.review_score)::numeric(10,4) AS average_review_score,
  COUNT(*) AS review_count
FROM orders o
JOIN order_reviews r
  ON o.order_id = r.order_id
WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
  AND r.review_score IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  CASE
    WHEN ABS(CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) - CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)) BETWEEN 0 AND 2 THEN '0-2 days'
    WHEN ABS(CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) - CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)) BETWEEN 3 AND 5 THEN '3-5 days'
    WHEN ABS(CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) - CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)) BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN '6-10 days'
    ELSE '11+ days'
  END
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN
      CASE
        WHEN ABS(CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) - CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)) BETWEEN 0 AND 2 THEN '0-2 days'
        WHEN ABS(CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) - CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)) BETWEEN 3 AND 5 THEN '3-5 days'
        WHEN ABS(CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) - CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)) BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN '6-10 days'
        ELSE '11+ days'
      END = '0-2 days' THEN 1
    WHEN
      CASE
        WHEN ABS(CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) - CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)) BETWEEN 0 AND 2 THEN '0-2 days'
        WHEN ABS(CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) - CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)) BETWEEN 3 AND 5 THEN '3-5 days'
        WHEN ABS(CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) - CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)) BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN '6-10 days'
        ELSE '11+ days'
      END = '3-5 days' THEN 2
    WHEN
      CASE
        WHEN ABS(CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) - CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)) BETWEEN 0 AND 2 THEN '0-2 days'
        WHEN ABS(CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) - CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)) BETWEEN 3 AND 5 THEN '3-5 days'
        WHEN ABS(CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) - CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)) BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN '6-10 days'
        ELSE '11+ days'
      END = '6-10 days' THEN 3
    ELSE 4
  END;
